records.question: How many customers do we have?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

records.question: How many products are in the Books category?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Books'

records.question: List all products that cost more than 5000 rupees.
records.generated_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE price > 5000

records.question: What is our most expensive product?
records.generated_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders were cancelled?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

records.question: What is the average product price?
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products

records.question: Which customers live in Kochi?
records.generated_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Kochi'

records.question: How many customers live outside India?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country <> 'India'

records.question: How many products does each category have?
records.generated_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

records.question: How many orders are still pending?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

records.question: What was our total revenue last month?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-1 month')
  AND order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month')

records.question: How many orders were placed this month?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month')

records.question: Show the revenue for each country.
records.generated_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country

records.question: Which 3 cities have the most customers?
records.generated_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: How many orders were placed in each month of 2025?
records.generated_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month

records.question: Which 5 products sold the most units?
records.generated_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5

records.question: What is the average order value of completed orders in each country?
records.generated_sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(AVG(o.total), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.country

records.question: How many different customers placed an order in the last 30 days?
records.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= date('2026-11-07', '-30 days')

records.question: How much revenue did the Electronics category make this year?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND p.category = 'Electronics'
  AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year')

records.question: Which customer has placed the most orders?
records.generated_sql: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many units were sold in each category last month?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-1 month')
  AND o.order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month')
GROUP BY p.category

records.question: What percentage of all orders were cancelled? Round to one decimal place.
records.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'cancelled') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM orders

records.question: Rank the top 10 customers by total spending this year.
records.generated_sql: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS spent FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year') GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: Show monthly revenue for this year and the change in rupees compared with the previous month.
records.generated_sql:
SELECT month, revenue, ROUND(revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS change FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS revenue
      FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year')
      GROUP BY month)

records.question: Which customers placed at least one order in each of the last 3 full calendar months?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of month', '-3 months')
  AND o.order_date < date('2026-11-07', 'start of month')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date)) = 3

records.question: Show revenue by city, and group customers without a known city as 'Unknown'.
records.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.city, 'Unknown') AS city, ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY COALESCE(c.city, 'Unknown')

records.question: Which customers signed up more than a year ago but have never placed an order?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT c.name FROM customers c WHERE c.signup_date < date('2026-11-07', '-1 year')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)

records.question: Which products have not been ordered at all in the last 7 days?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT p.name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
                  WHERE oi.product_id = p.id AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', '-7 days'))

records.question: What share of this year's revenue comes from each product category, as a percentage rounded to one decimal?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT p.category,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (), 1)
FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year') GROUP BY p.category

records.question: What is the second most expensive product in each category?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT category, name FROM (
  SELECT category, name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC) AS rn
  FROM products) WHERE rn = 2

records.question: Show the cumulative revenue by month for this year.
records.generated_sql:
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total) AS revenue
      FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= date('2026-11-07', 'start of year')
      GROUP BY month)

records.question: Which products share the most common price?
records.generated_sql:
SELECT name FROM products WHERE price = (
  SELECT price FROM products GROUP BY price ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

records.question: Who are our best customers?
records.generated_sql: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC LIMIT 10

records.question: How are sales doing this year?
